en:
>Welcome (name), to Aphid Festival Resort!
This is an early version of the game and does not reflect future updates.
>Press Escape to access the [color=red]Help and Controls[/color] information panels!
Otherwise, talk to some of the characters to know more!
>You can check updates at the Itch.io page of the game!
Any feedback is appreciated.
es:
>Bienvenido (name), a Aphid Festival Resort!
Esta es una version temprana del juego y no refleja actualizaciones futuras.
>Presiona Escape para acceder a paneles de informacion sobre [color=red]Ayuda y Controles[/color]!
O conversa con los personjes para saber más!
>Puedes encontrar actualizaciones en la pagina de Itch.io del juego!
Cualquier feedback es agradecido.

en:
>Hello!(...) You are (name), right? Come on in!(...)
I'll give you a quick tour around!
es:
>Hola!(...) Tu tienes que ser (name), ¿no? Adelante!(...)
Te dare un paseo!

en:
>Here it is. The aphid resort!(...)
So,(...) what do you think?
>It's not a lot, but you can go ahead and play around it!(...)
As a premium member, it is your right to do so, after all.
>Here in the kitchen you can turn ingredients into full course meals if you want
your aphids to grow even stronger!
>To the side we have the lobby! 
Here you can check on the latest changes we do, exchange aphids with other guests
and even send them to needed jobs and get a cut out of it.
>The owner is not around for the moment but be sure to say hello if
you see him! Otherwise, we have plenty of guests you can interact with.
>That over there is the resort's shop, you can use your berries to buy supplies and toys
for the little ones!
>We would also offer hats but... those have not reached us yet(...)
Sorry for the incoveniences.
>Well! If you need me, I'll be just here on watch duty!(...)
Don't be afraid to talk to any of us if you need help with something(...)
They may even know a few things about aphids!
es:
>Y aqui esta, el complejo de áfidos!
Agradable, ¿no?
>No es mucho... ¡pero puedes arreglar cosas a tu gusto!

en:
>Quite a cozy place, isn’t it (name)?(...)
It’s such a joy to work as a keeper for the lil buddies. (...)
[wave amp=50.0 freq=5.0 connected=1]They even let me have my own one![/wave]
>Her name is Crystal.(...) Isn't she a cutie? 
>Just wished more bugs came along to visit...(...)
Apart from festival times, it gets pretty quiet around here.(...)
>Speaking of, I think that is coming pretty soon!(...[0.5])
hopefully...
es:
>Un lugar agradable, no es así (name)?(...)
Me encanta trabajar de cuidadora para los pequeñines.(...)
[wave amp=50.0 freq=5.0 connected=1]Incluso me dejan tener el mió propio! [/wave]
>Su nombre es Cristal(...), a que es una ternura!
>Solo desearia que más bichos se pasasen por aquí...(...)
Aparte de en tiempos de festival, este lugar es bastante silencioso.
>Hablando de aquello, creo que esta por llegar!(...[0.5])
espero...

en:
>They are still filling the resort with all sorts of wonders(...)
So sorry for all the mess of boxes! They won't let me touch them.
>I don't know why either, that moth at the gate told me not to.
>When I got nearby one, they just gave me a death stare(...)
So I stay away from them ever since...
es:
>Todavia estan llenando el complejo con todo tipo de artilugios(...)
Asi que lo siento por el monton de cajas! No me dejan tocarlas.
>Yo tampoco lo se, aquella polilla en la entrada me dijo que no podia.
>Cuando me acerque a una, me devolvio una mirada asesina(...)
Desde entonces no me acerco...

en:
>Aphid breeding has been on the rise lately.(...)
Towns outside the Golden Settlement are requiring more and more aphids for all sorts of things.(...)
Makes me wonder why...
>You can pay a visit to the lobby to know more!
Wheter that is selling some to them, or just for a quick job.
es:
>La crianza de afidos ha estado en la alza utlimamente.(...)
Pueblos fuera del Asentamiento estan necesitando cada vez más y más áfidos para usos diversos. (...)
Me pregunto el motivo...
>Puedes pasarte por el lobby para saber más!
Ya seá para vender unos cuantos, o para un encargo rápido.

en:
>Remember to treat your Aphids with respect!
They need love and care if you want them to grow big and strong.
es:
>Recuerda tratar tus Áfidos con amor y cariño!
Necesitaran de todo el cuidado del mundo si quieres verlos crecer
grandes y fuertes.

en:
>Did you know how much personality can a single Aphid have?
(...)Well now you'll do!
>Surely, you have seen each one act different than others?(...)
Aphids have all sorts of little unique traits that make them so unique!
>[wave amp=25.0 freq=5.0 connected=1]I spend so much time just watching them go...[/wave](...)
I wonder what they are saying?
es:
>¿Sabes cuanta personalidad puede un áfido tener?
(...)Bueno, ¡ahora lo sabras!
>De seguro, ¿No habras visto como cada uno actua diferente que los otros?(...)
¡Los áfidos tienen todo tipo de rasgos que los hacen tan unicos!
>[wave amp=25.0 freq=5.0 connected=1]Paso mucho tiempo verlos ir y venir...[/wave](...)
¿Me pregunto de que hablaran?

en:
>Mmh...(...)
Oh, sorry, didn't see you there!
>I tune out a little too much, too often.(...)
I really like to take in the air...
es:
>Mmh...(...)
Oh perdona, no te vi llegar!
>A veces se me va mucho el pensamiento.(...)
Realmente me gusta disfrutar el tiempo...

en:
>(name)! Hello, Hello!
If you need anything, I have it right here!
And if I don't, maybe later. 
>Except, weapons, they do not allow me to sell you darts
Not like you need them anyways!
es:
>(name)! Hey, Hey!
Si necesitas algo, lo tengo aqui mismo!
Y si no... pues puede que luego.
>Excepto armas, no me permiten venderte dardos.
No es lo que necesites de todos modos!

en:
>I heard lots of stories of the guy who owns this resort(...)
Apparently he's gone adventuring a tad lot in the past.
>Not suprised for how much it costs to upkeep this place(...)
It takes the entire queen's wealth and much more!
es:
>He oido muchas historias sobre el tipo que lleva el complejo(...)
Aparentemente solía irse de aventura con frecuencia en el pasado.
>No me sorprende teniendo en cuenta el costo de mantenimiento de este sitio.(...)
Requiere la entera riqueza de la reina misma y mucho más!

en:
>I wonder how  things are up there with the Wasps?(...)
I left that place [wave amp=25.0 freq=5.0 connected=1]loooong[/wave] ago but I 'ear some stuff recently.
>Maybe it was for the best. I enjoy life 'ere in the settlement anyways.
Even met my partner thanks to it. So bless Venus and allat.
>Oh sorry, there goes me rambling again...(...)
What'cha need, (name)?
es:
>Me pregunto que estaran haciendo las Avispas en el norte?(...)
Deje ese lugar hace [wave amp=25.0 freq=5.0 connected=1]baaastante[/wave] rato, pero he oido cosas recientemente.
>Creo que fue lo mejor. Disfruto la vida aquí en el asentamiento.
Incluso conoci a mi pareja aqui. Así que, gracias a Venus y demas charla.
>Oops, perdona, se me ha ido el hilo otra vez....(...)
¿Que necesitas, (name)?

en:
>Have you seen Echo?(...)
I need 'em to go pick more supplies.(...)
>Don't fear them, they a good moth.(...)
I brought 'em to the settlement to relax for a bit.
>But once in a moon they seem unable to do so.
>[color=grey][wave amp=25.0 freq=5.0 connected=1]sigh[/wave][/color]. I really appreciate them trying.(...)
Hard times, ya know?
es:
>¿Has visto a Echo?(...)
Ocupo que se encargen de unos mandados(...)
>No les temas mucho, son una polilla amable.(...)
Les traje al asentamiento para relajarse por un tiempo.
>Pero en ocasion, algo de estres se llevan.
>[color=grey][wave amp=25.0 freq=5.0 connected=1]suspiro[/wave][/color] . Aprecio que lo intenten.(...)
Tiempos dificiles, ¿sabes?

en:
>No one in this town has proved more expert taste than the aphids.
They are the best customers I ever had.
>They even gather around to see my craft.(...)
[wave amp=25.0 freq=5.0 connected=1]Truly an inspiring environment.[/wave]
es:
>Nadie en este pueblo ha provado tener un sentido del gusto tan exquisito como los áfidos.
Los mejores clientes que uno puede pedir.
>Incluso se reunen para verme crear arte.(...)
[wave amp=25.0 freq=5.0 connected=1]Un ambiente asi me inspira.[/wave]

en:
>Mmpfh...(...)
Should I try spice it up(...) or(...) should I make it sickly sweet.
>...(...)Oh, you're...(...[0.7]) (name)?(...)
Have you come to see a culinary expert in action?
es:
>Mmpfh...(...)
¿Deberia intentar añadirle picor(...) o hacerlo amargamente dulce?.
>...(...)Oh, tu eres...(...[0.7]) (name)?(...)
¿Has venido a ver a un maestro culinario en acción?

en:
>...What would I recommend? (...)
That is up to your little one.
>They all have an unique afinity to a particular flavour.
Some more...(...) different than others.
>Sour(...), Sweet(...), Salty(...) and Bitter.(...)
All depends on the ingredients you use.
es:
>¿Que es lo que recomendaria?(...)
Eso lo dicta tu pequeñin.
>Todos tiene una afinidad a un sabor particular.
Algunos más...(...) diferentes que otros.
>Agrio(...), Dulce(...), Salado(...) y Amargo.(...)
Todo depende en los ingredientes que uses.

en:
>Don't keep me waiting and bring me some ingredients.
Go on!
es:
>No me dejes esperando y traéme ingredientes.
Vamos!

en: >Fi
es: >Fi

en: >Fi Fi
es: >Fi Fi

en: >[wave amp=25.0 freq=5.0 connected=1][color='grey']squeak
es: >[wave amp=25.0 freq=5.0 connected=1][color='grey']chi chi

en:
>Fi fi(...)
Fi?
es:
>Fi fi(...)
Fi?

en:
>...(...)What do you want?(...)
Don't I look busy to you?
>Are you lost or what?
>...(...[0.7])Oh bother(...), you really are.
>I am pretty sure they gave you a [color=red]Help[/color] guide(...)
It would be a good idea if you read it, don't you think.
es:
>...(...)¿Que es lo que buscas?(...)
¿No te parezco ocupade?
>¿Estas perdid(o/a) o qué?
>...(...[0.7])Oh(...), lo estas, no es cierto.
>Estoy segure que te han dado una guía de [color=red]ayuda[/color](...)
Sería una buena idea leerlo ahora, no te parece.

en:
>No.(...) You cannot take the aphids outside.
>...(...)Yes. [shake]You[/shake] can go outside. I'm not your mother.
es:
>No. No puedes llevarte a los áfidos afuera.
>...(...)Si, [shake]tu[/shake] puedes salir, no soy tu madre.

en:
>[font_size=20]...Did I really have to join her for this...[/font_size]
>Erhm, hello?(...)
Could you mind your own business?
es:
>[font_size=20]...De verdad tenia que formar parte de esto por ella...[/font_size]
>Huh, ¿hola?(...)
¿Te importa?

en:
>Have you ever seen the Giant's Lair?(...)
Me neither(...), but I heard exciting things.
>A pretty fun adventure, in and out. (...)Mostly in.(...)
Out was the hard part.
es:
>¿Alguna vez has visto la Tierra de los Gigantes?(...)
Yo tampoco.(...) Pero he escuchado cosas sorprendentes.
>Una aventura de locos, de ida y vuelta. (...)Mayormente ida.(...)
Vuelta era la parte dificíl.

en:
>Don't cause trouble. I am watching you.(...)
All four of my eyes are.
es:
>No causes problemas, te estoy vigilando.(...)
Mis cuatro ojos lo hacen.

en:
>They hired me to guard the resort 
but all I do is watch for these [shake rate=20.0 level=6 connected=0]dumb[/shake] boxes.
>There is no way anything bigger than a seedling is gonna come knocking the door.(...)
But I sure wished...
es:
>Me contrataron para hacer de guardia en el complejo,
pero todo lo que hago es solo mirar estas [shake rate=20.0 level=6 connected=0]estupidas[/shake] cajas.
>No hay manera que cualquier cosa más grande que un áfido sea capaz
de venir a tocar la puerta.(...)
Solo puedo rezar...

en:
>Whatcha looking at?(...)
Does my horn have something on it?
>[shake][font_size=80]Ough![/font_size][/shake]
Why are you giggling!
es:
>¿Que miras?(...)
¿Mi cuerno tiene algo?
>[shake][font_size=80]Ough![/font_size][/shake]
¡Por qué te ries!

en:
>I come from [wave amp=50.0 freq=5.0 connected=0]very faaaar away[/wave](...)
You can tell because I'm not like anyone else!
>I'm strong(...), fast(...), intelligent(...), and strong!
es:
>Vengo de [wave amp=50.0 freq=5.0 connected=0]muuuuuy lejos[/wave](...)
Puedes notarlo porque no soy como los demas!
>Soy fuerte(...), veloz(...), intelligente(...) y fuerte!

en:
>They said the hats would come today, but I don't see them!
How dare they!
>Until then, your aphids will be hatless(...)
Sad!
es:
>Dijeron que los sombreros vendrían hoy, ¡pero no los veo!
¡Cómo se atreven!
>Hasta entonces, tus áfidos estaran calvos.(...)
¡Que pena!

en:
>I would be inside but  the guard at the entrance won't let me.
Rude!
>I could beat them myself but...(...)
I do need my hats, where are they!
es:
>Entraria, pero el guarda en la entrada no me deja.
Terrible!
>Podria hacer algo al respecto pero...(...)
De verdad que necesito mis sombreros ¡Donde estan!

en:
I require the assistance of brave, intrepid aphids, to mow the grass!
This grass tufts are blocking my whole yard and I need them OUT.
es:
Necesito la asistencia de intrepidos y valerosos áfidos, para cortar hierba!
Estos mates estan invadiendo mi jardín y los quiero FUERA.

en:
Needing a few aphids for crate transportation.
Preferably, with five years of entry experience.
es:
Necesito un par de áfidos para transporte de suministros.
Preferiblemente con cinco años de experiencia como practicante.

en:
Doing some research in lesser bugs.
I just need one who listens well, that's all...
es:
Haciendo una investigación en bichos menores.
Solo necesito uno que sepa escuchar, eso es todo...

en:
Needing some advertising on the go!
No skills required, just a lot of enthusiasm!
es:
Necesitamos publicidad!
No se necesitan habilidades, solo un monton de entusiasmo!

en:
In need of delivery bugs. We need them now and fast!
We got lots of packages already, so please contact us 
as soon as you can.
es:
Necesitamos bichos de servicio. Ahora o nunca!
Tenemos varios paquetes que se acumulan, así que porfavor, contactenos lo más rapido que se pueda.

en:
Looking to rent an aphid for a school class. The children would love it!
Just need it to be well behaved.
es:
Viendo si puedo rentar un áfido para una clase.
Estoy segura que a los chicos les encantara!
Solo lo necesito que sea bien portado.

en:
There's lots of treasure hidden beneath the sands.
We could do with a few lil scavengers.
es:
Hay varios tesoros enterados debajo de las arenas.
Nos podrian ser utiles un par de recolletores.

en:
Requesting aphids for general therapy and support services.
Only requirement is for them to understand my orders.
es:
Requerio áfidos para fines de terapia y servicios de salud.
Unico requerimiento es que entiendan mis ordenes.

en:
Local workers needing a hand for land renovation!
Sapling, grass and rock eaters welcome.
es: WIP

en:
Having a problem with some unwanted guests!
Requesting some aphids that can slice the life out of this weeds.
es: WIP

en:
We need a hand for berry transport.
We'll even give you a part of the supply as thanks! (Just don't tell the queen)
es: WIP

en: Emergency crew in need of a trained searcher for the rescue of lost explorers.
es: WIP

en:
Work in the tunnels is getting rough.
Will be needing some extra hands on board.
es: WIP

en:
Help Wanted! The theater requires actors, great and handsome actors!
Respond to this request if you think you have what I want.
es: WIP

en:
Requesting assistance for bridge repair operation.
The stronger, the better.
es: WIP

en:
Requesting a playmate for Chompy, let it be known, she plays rough.
Looking forward to it.
es: WIP

en:
The queen has requested to see one of your aphids from the resort.
She states that “they look like little adorable fellas” and such demands a demonstration.
Bring one of great mind alike!
es: WIP

en:
The chomp infestation is getting out of hands.
Requesting the strongest bugs the settlement can send, quick!
es: WIP

en:
Going on a hunt for golden seedlings, and I will need an aphid companion,
who is tougher than the toughies, smarter than the smarties,
and sharper than the sharpies.
es: WIP

en:
Threat arises from the shadows, requesting strong companions for
pest control.

I need someone to go fetch me some ingredients, and it better be quick!
Just leave them by the door.

Scout teams need to follow a trace for a potential nest of mantidflies, 
and they could with someone that has a better sense of smell.

Attacks by the deadlanders have obliterated our camps.
We plead for a loyal guard who can keep them at bay.
es: WIP

en:
Adventuring deeper on unknown areas, and as the paths become more puzzling,
we need a companion who can wiggle us out of trouble.
es: WIP

en:
(The request note is barely legible but you can see the crude drawing of an aphid)
(It also has a berry symbol on it so I guess is not a threat either)

Needing some test subjects for sustained battle simulations
and I heard from a friend one of you could grant me one worthy subject.
